name: Obsidian Mirror Maze
description: A labyrinth of polished obsidian mirrors reflecting a cosmos of nebulae, creating endless star‑filled corridors.
prompt: First‑person view inside a maze: walls, floor, ceiling are flawless obsidian mirrors. Each reflection shows a deep space nebula — purple, teal, gold — giving the illusion of infinite cosmic tunnels. Soft ambient glow. Hyper‑realistic, 8K.
caption: Lose yourself in a maze that mirrors the universe. 🌌🖤 #ObsidianMirrorMaze
